items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Lauren Tokens, quite naturally, he followed me to play with Chris Kelly

ctx.x: Yeah. And they was- Some of them would jump ship and stay there.

Yeah, they would. That's what they all would do. They had no passports. Some of them was stowed away. So we start to playing. So around 1130, Lauren Tokens, quite naturally, he followed me to play with Chris Kelly to see how I was going to make up. About 1130, Chris Kelly asked him to raise him up.
